cloudcli_base_url.hint: The URL where CloudCLI UI is running, for example http://127.0.0.1:3001.

cloudcli_jwt_token.hint: Optional. If empty, the plugin will try username/password login.

cloudcli_username.hint: Optional. Used to login to /api/auth/login when cloudcli_jwt_token is empty.

cloudcli_password.hint: Optional. Used to login to /api/auth/login when cloudcli_jwt_token is empty.

cloudcli_api_key.hint: Required for /cloudcli run. Also required for protected REST/WS endpoints when CloudCLI server was started with API_KEY.

allow_unauthenticated_ws.hint: Only enable when CloudCLI is in a trusted platform mode that does not require WS tokens.

agent_idle_timeout_seconds.hint: Abort /cloudcli run when the CloudCLI agent stream sends no data for this many seconds.

agent_max_duration_seconds.hint: Maximum seconds to wait for one /cloudcli run task. Set 0 to disable this guard.

session_allowed_user_keys.description: Comma-separated AstrBot user keys allowed to access sessions
session_allowed_user_keys.hint: Users in this list can list, bind, and read CloudCLI sessions even if they are not AstrBot admins. Stopping sessions uses stop_allowed_user_keys.

session_require_admin.description: Require AstrBot admin for session commands
session_require_admin.hint: When enabled, only AstrBot admins or session_allowed_user_keys can list, bind, or read sessions.

session_access_mode.hint: Supported values: admin_or_allowlist, allowlist_only, authenticated. This explicit mode is preferred over session_require_admin.

stop_allowed_user_keys.description: Comma-separated AstrBot user keys allowed to stop CloudCLI sessions
stop_allowed_user_keys.hint: Users in this list can use /cloudcli stop even if they are not AstrBot admins.

stop_require_admin.hint: When enabled, only AstrBot admins or stop_allowed_user_keys can stop sessions.

stop_access_mode.hint: Supported values: admin_or_allowlist, allowlist_only, authenticated. This is intentionally separate from session_access_mode.

allow_direct_session_id.hint: When disabled, non-admin users must use bound sessions or IDs from their latest /cloudcli session index.

recent_sessions_limit.description: Max recent sessions shown by /cloudcli session

chat_messages_limit.description: Default recent messages shown by /cloudcli chat

max_run_message_length.description: Max task length accepted by /cloudcli run

run_allowed_user_keys.description: Comma-separated AstrBot user keys allowed to run CloudCLI agent tasks
run_allowed_user_keys.hint: Users in this list can use /cloudcli run even if they are not AstrBot admins.

run_require_admin.hint: When enabled, only AstrBot admins or run_allowed_user_keys can start CloudCLI agent tasks.

run_access_mode.hint: Supported values: admin_or_allowlist, allowlist_only, authenticated. This explicit mode is preferred over run_require_admin.

allowed_project_roots.description: Comma-separated local project roots allowed for /cloudcli run --project
allowed_project_roots.hint: Recommended for any non-admin run access. Paths outside these roots are rejected.

allow_unrestricted_project_paths.hint: Only applies to non-admin users when allowed_project_roots is empty. Only enable in fully trusted chats. Admin users are allowed even when this is false.

max_active_runs_per_user.description: Max concurrent /cloudcli run tasks per user

max_run_history_per_user.description: Max completed /cloudcli run tasks retained per user
max_run_history_per_user.hint: Set 0 to keep all run history for each user.

max_run_history_global.description: Max completed /cloudcli run tasks retained globally
max_run_history_global.hint: Set 0 to keep all run history globally.

persist_sensitive_state.description: Persist sensitive run and approval details
persist_sensitive_state.hint: When false, approval input bodies, audit input summaries, and raw run messages are kept only in memory or replaced with placeholders in state.json.

run_status_interval_seconds.description: Minimum seconds between background run status pushes

max_run_status_pushes.description: Max status push messages for one /cloudcli run task

run_list_limit.description: Default task count shown by /cloudcli run list

approval_allowed_user_keys.description: Comma-separated AstrBot user keys allowed to approve permissions
approval_allowed_user_keys.hint: Users in this list can approve even if they are not AstrBot admins and can receive proactive approval details. They may bind a known sessionId for approval handling without getting session browsing access. Use /cloudcli whoami to get the key.

approval_require_admin.hint: When enabled, only AstrBot admins or approval_allowed_user_keys can view, approve, or deny requests. Proactive approval details are sent only to approval_allowed_user_keys.

approval_access_mode.hint: Supported values: admin_or_allowlist, allowlist_only, authenticated. This explicit mode is preferred over approval_require_admin.

approval_allow_direct_session_bind.description: Allow approval users to bind raw session IDs
approval_allow_direct_session_bind.hint: When false, approval allowlist users cannot bind arbitrary raw sessionId values unless they are admins or direct session usage is separately allowed.

approval_timeout_seconds.description: Seconds before pending approval timeout action; 0 disables it

approval_timeout_action.hint: Supported values: remind or deny. deny will automatically reject the request after timeout.
